_comment: Authoritative per-operation costs MEASURED by the substrate sisters' own criterion benchmark suites. CIRISConformance does NOT re-measure these in isolation — the sister suites own them. These are the numbers the CEWP scaling model (ciris.ai/cewp, src/app/cewp/lib/model.ts) is calibrated against. The conformance benchmark tier measures the CROSS-WHEEL composite + Python-boundary cost on top of these (see bench_substrate.py); the delta is the cohabitation/FFI tax a real cohabiting caller pays.
source: model.ts empirical constants + the sister-repo criterion suites

per_op_reference._realtime_av_comment: Realtime A/V mesh profile (CIRISEdge#62 realtime_av, CEG 0.13 §10.5.8) — the two-layer hybrid-PQC group-video crypto. Owned + measured by CIRISServer benches/pqc_av_streaming.rs (the realtime_av + federation_session KEX surfaces are Rust-only, not on the Python wheel, so the cross-wheel Python bench is pending CIRISEdge PyO3 exposure — these are the owner criterion numbers in the meantime). Triple: persist 6.8.1 / edge 3.5.0 / verify 5.4.0.

av_kex_hybrid.note: hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 full handshake (initiate 71us + respond 99us); per-link, one-time

av_kex_classical.note: classical X25519-only handshake; ML-KEM-768 adds ~89us once per peer-link

av_mesh_fanout_naive_50.note: per-frame sender CPU, 50-participant mesh, current seal_av_chunk x N
